message: 過去を越えていけ！
While having tea together, we look through last year's Student Council activity records--the Holy Night Festival photo album.
The photos show the culture hall solemnly decorated.

name: Synn
message: 「Last year's Holy Night Festival was so wonderful~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course it was, since Big Sister planned it. It was a magnificent, deeply sacred event overflowing with joy...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Was it really~\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The communion service, the candlelight service, the dance party... there were a lot of first-time experiences for us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「First-time experiences! Now that's another arousing phrase!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Truly romantic...\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it was that well-received, we've gotta go with the same thing this year!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'd love to play with fire using candles~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. You say that so casually, but is it really that easy to pull off?」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed. Perhaps that was only possible because Big Sister was leading the Student Council...」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No... like I said, I didn't do anything all that extraordinary...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem, excuse me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, that's right. Last year was last year, and this year is this year.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's our advisor!」

name: Ria
message: 「Suppose we did the exact same Holy Night Festival as last year... What would you think, Lolotte-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's my first time! So I'm really looking forward to it!」

name: Ria
message: 「But what about everyone else?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Rehashing, recasting, reusing, and monkey-dancing the exact same thing as last year」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That wouldn't be very interesting at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if I'm being greedy, I'd kinda like to see a different kind of Holy Night Festival too. Memorizing all those hymns is tough, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Students like Nanaka-san make up the majority, don't they...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What you'd call the mainstream, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Either way, even if we tried to do the exact same thing as last year, we wouldn't be able to faithfully recreate it anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case! Why don't we just go ahead and make something totally new ourselves!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! That is a wonderful idea!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. That's way faster than making minor tweaks」

name: Misa
message: 「However, trying something new means taking on a fair amount of risk, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... True. I mean, we might end up failing, sure...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, wouldn't it be way, way more fun if we hyped things up in our own way!」

name: Misa
message: 「Our own way...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To put it bluntly, making it up as we go along」

name: Lolotte
message: 「While I am curious about last year's first-time experience, something brand new is more than welcome in its own right!」

name: Misa
message: 「Fine by me. If the alternative is getting cold feet in front of Sakura-kun, I'll gladly take on the challenge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah! Then me too, me too! I'm rooting for Synn as well! I'll back you up, I'll help you out!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey now! Don't twist my words to make it sound misleading!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is a rather different kind of appeal from mere enthusiasm, Treasurer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Shut up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you getting mad at me!\s06」

name: Ria
message: 「Taking on fun challenges without fearing failure」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Just what you'd expect from the people who made KiraFes a success♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if we fail, it will be alright. Everyone will just laugh and forgive us!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nanaka Chop!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawuh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we're doing this, we're aiming for the win right from the start!」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course」

name: Synn
message: 「So, does that mean for this year's Holy Night Festival... we're going to pull out all the stops again, just like we did for KiraFes?」

name: Everyone
message: 「No objections!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Since you're the one who brought it up, you've already got something fun... planned out, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, I was thinking we could come up with something starting right now\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「All together, right\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, ooh!! When you think of Christmas, you gotta have sweets!! Let's all eat together--Christmas!」

name: Misa
message: 「How about we try giving traditional hymns a modern, trendy arrangement!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I would love to try having something like a costume party!!」
Throwing around various ideas like that, we hammered out our proposal right there on the spot.
